newsitem.title: USA: Richmond Fed-March manufacturing, services indexes.
newsitem.headline: Richmond Fed-March manufacturing, services indexes.

text.p: Federal Reserve Bank of Richmond indexes monitoring manufacturing and service-sector activity.

Note -- Each index equals the percentage of responding firms reporting increases minus the percentage reporting decreases. Prices received and prices paid are in response to the question "What do you believe was the percentage price change in your industry on an annualized basis?"
Results of the March manufacturing survey are based on responses from 95 of 179 firms queried. Results of the March service-sector survey are based on responses from 69 of 123 firms.
The Richmond Fed said that the sharp gain in the March shipments index was the largest monthly increase in the history of the survey.
It said the service revenues index of 43 in March was the highest ever for the series.
